profile.headline: Information Technology Specialist at Internal Revenue Service
profile.summary: Ricardo Torres, MCPD, MCTS. Currently working for the Treasury Department at the Internal Revenue Service with Over 20 years of experience in the IT field. Strong foundation in the .NET framework, SQL, MVC, LINQ, JQuery, HTML5, extensive windows and web development, SharePoint development, Developing Secured Systems.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Working as part of a Modernization team with a mission to develop new generation software systems for the IRS.

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer & Sharepoint Solutions Developer
positions.description: Design, Architect and Develop complex .Net web applications for the US Army. Build custom SharePoint Solutions for the US Army Cyber Operations and Defense department using .Net technologies, SP2013, SP Designer, LINQ, JQuery, BCS, CAML, Web Services, SSIS, BI, Angular, build apps using the SP2013 App Model, Perform presentations, demos, mentor team members, provide expert advise on new technologies and implementations, Mitigate Risks, Implement Secure Coding Practices, Fortify, other.

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer
positions.description: Developed custom Sharepoint solutions for the US Army Public Health Command. Supported over 100+ .Net applications. Technologies used: MVC, LINQ, JQuery, WCF, other.
